title: A coarse uniform upper bound for ordinary etale compact support
statement: For a finite commutative coefficient ring $\Lambda$ and schemes $X,Y$, let $c=(j,r)$ be a compactification of $f:X\to Y$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and assume $Y$ is quasi-compact. In the ordinary etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with the standard t-structure [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], there exists $N\in\mathbb{N}$ such that $Rr_*Dj_!$ sends every $K\in D^{\leq a}(X_{et},\Lambda)$ into $D^{\leq a+N}(Y_{et},\Lambda)$, for every integer $a$. No boundedness below or bound on the original fibres is assumed.

source.place: lemma-derived-lower-shriek-bounded, assertion (3), torsion coefficient case, lines 3574–3610

proof.text: The proper map r has uniformly bounded geometric fibre dimensions over the quasi-compact base Y. Proper base change and the torsion cohomological-dimension theorem give a uniform classical cohomological-dimension bound N for r_* with finite module coefficients.

The finite-dimensional unbounded derived-functor theorem gives Rr_*(D^{≤a})⊆D^{≤a+N}. Exact extension by zero preserves D^{≤a}, so its composite with Rr_* satisfies the same bound. This is already proved by the attached source-library theorem; no new Lean construction is introduced.
